name: io.github.api-freaks/apifreaks-mcp
title: APIFreaks MCP
description: APIFreaks MCP: live APIs for agents. Enable modules with ENABLE_MODULES; discover via list_modules.

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your APIFreaks API key — get one free at apifreaks.com

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to register (e.g. ip-intelligence,whois,dns,domain,weather). If unset, only list_modules is available — call it for needs_enable[] and a paste-ready ENABLE_MODULES=... line, then restart. Available: ip-intelligence, geocoding, whois, dns, scraper, email-validation, phone-validation, ssl, domain, screenshot, pdf, currency, commodity, financial, zipcode, weather, geography, timezone, user-agent
